narratives.Description: Four consumer-setup fixes ship in 0.130.1, before 0.130.x is promoted to npm latest. Setup replaces .githooks files by temp file and rename, the deposited pre-commit runs forward coverage warn-only, getting-started creates the feature branch before the deposit commit, and the deposited .gitignore ignores Directive runtime state. Each fix is specified in its own issue: #6806, #6807, #6800 and #6795.
narratives.Overview:
Four consumer-setup fixes for 0.130.1, before 0.130.x is promoted to npm `latest`. Each one is described in its own issue: #6806, #6807, #6800 and #6795.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Setup writes `.githooks/*` replacements to a temp file in the same directory and renames it over the target, so a shell already running the old hook keeps reading the old file (#6806).
- [ ] A test runs the old pre-commit body under bash while self-complete replaces the hooks, and the commit succeeds (#6806).
- [ ] The deposited `pre-commit` runs forward coverage warn-only: a missing paired test prints the finding and does not fail the commit. CI and `deft check` behaviour is unchanged (#6807).
- [ ] The setup hook-body test pins the warn-only forward-coverage form (#6807).
- [ ] `content/docs/getting-started.md`, and any setup skill text with the same order, has the first-project path create the feature branch before the deposit commit (#6800).
- [ ] The deposited consumer `.gitignore` ignores Directive runtime state under `.deft/` and `.deft-cache/`, while keeping `.deft/approved-scope/` and `.deft/intent-constraint/` trackable (#6795).
- [ ] A test shows that after `session:start` in a fresh install, `git status --porcelain` lists no Directive runtime file (#6795).
- [ ] One CHANGELOG fragment covers the four consumer-facing changes.

Refs #6806, #6807, #6800, #6795

narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer, I want setup to replace git hooks without breaking a running hook, the deposited pre-commit to warn on missing paired tests, a first-project guide that starts on a feature branch, and runtime state kept out of git status, so that a pin bump or a fresh install never breaks or dirties my commits.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Hook write path (#6806): in packages/runtime/src/setup-wiring.ts, write each changed .githooks/* file to a temp file in the same directory and rename it over the target (containedWrite + containedRename from packages/core/src/fs/contained-write.ts); other deposit writes are unchanged. Test: packages/runtime/src/setup-wiring-hook-replace-6806.test.ts runs the old pre-commit body under bash while self-complete replaces the hooks and asserts the commit succeeds.
- Warn-only forward coverage (#6807): change the PRE_COMMIT body in setup-wiring.ts (with a warn mode in packages/runtime/src/verify-forward-coverage.ts if needed) so a missing paired test prints the finding and exits 0; CI and deft check keep the failing form. Test: setup-wiring-tracked-hooks.test.ts pins the warn-only line.
- Runtime gitignore (#6795): change DIRECTIVE_GITIGNORE_LINES in packages/core/src/install-health/owned-paths.ts to ignore .deft/* and .deft-cache/ while keeping .deft/plan-sequence.json, .deft/GENERATION.json, .deft/approved-scope/** and .deft/intent-constraint/** trackable (plus the approved-scope and intent-constraint temp-file ignores). Setup (packages/runtime/src/setup.ts), the doctor coverage check (packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts) and uninstall line matching handle the ! lines. Tests: owned-paths, checks and doctor-read-only tests, and packages/runtime/src/session-start-gitignore-6795.test.ts asserts git status --porcelain lists no runtime file after session:start in a fresh install.
- Docs (#6800): content/docs/getting-started.md step 6 creates the feature branch before the deposit commit; first_project_journey.test.ts stays green.
- Changelog: one fragment changelog.d/6808-consumer-setup-fixes.md; verify with the three stated vitest commands.
